title: South Korean grape exports jump 85% as Taiwan leads sales
caption:
South Korea's fresh grape exports soared to over $90 million this year, with Taiwan purchasing more than half the country's entire shipment. The fruit boom managed to rescue South Korea's total fresh produce balance, even as other crop exports faced steep drops.

Source: Koreaherald - South Korean grape exports jump 85% as Taiwan leads sales
